Project Reference
National Immunization Registry Modernization
ClientNational Ministry of Health
Duration10 months (development) + 12 months (support)
Team Size14 (Project Manager, Solutions Architect, 3 Full-Stack Developers, 2 Mobile Developers, QA Lead, Data Privacy Specialist, and support staff)
BudgetUSD 410,000
ScopeDesign and deployment of a registry and case-tracking platform across 40+ clinics, with integration into the national health data exchange and an offline-capable mobile app for field health workers.
ResultDelivered on budget and on schedule; adopted as the national standard platform for immunization case tracking, now used by over 500 field staff.
